subheading: PREDISPOSING FACTORS TO DEEP VEIN THROMBOSIS
subheading_corrected: PREDISPOSING FACTORS TO DEEP VEIN THROMBOSIS
text:
PREDISPOSING FACTORS TO DEEP VEIN THROMBOSIS
- Old age
- Obesity
- Hyper-coagulable states
- Long periods of immobilization e.g. cardiac failure, following surgery,
long-distance travel, etc
- Varicose veins
- Pregnancy and puerperium
- Malignancies
